product_launches.description: Tomorrow Health launched its Horizon Suite, a new set of agentic AI products including AI Ordering, AI Fax Intake, THEA, and AI Benefit Management to streamline ordering, routing, and fulfillment of durable medical equipment for home-based care.

overview_description.description:
Tomorrow Health is a technology-driven home healthcare company changing the way individuals and families manage their care. It brings together personal service and modern technology to get their clients the products and supplies they need.

Tomorrow Health connect providers, health plans, and home-based care suppliers, to ensure that patients can access care even in their home.

Founded in 2018, the company is headquartered in New York, New York, United States.

identifier.value: Tomorrow Health Home Care Coordination Platform

product.name: Tomorrow Health Home Care Coordination Platform
product.description: A technology platform that coordinates home-based healthcare by connecting patients, providers, health plans, and medical equipment suppliers.

product.name: Automated DME Ordering and Fulfillment
product.description: A service that streamlines the ordering, insurance coordination, and delivery of durable medical equipment and related home-care supplies.

product.name: Home Medical Equipment and Supplies
product.description: Access to durable medical equipment and supplies for home-based care, including respiratory, mobility, hospital, diabetic, wound, urology, ostomy, nutrition, and postpartum products.

product.name: CPAP Sleep Care Program
product.description: A sleep-apnea equipment service providing CPAP devices, replacement supplies, insurance-based ordering, mask support, and remote sleep-coach assistance.

product.name: Care Advocates and Patient Support
product.description: Human support for patients and care teams with home-equipment ordering, product selection, treatment questions, and order-related assistance.

product.name: Insurance and Benefit Coordination
product.description: Coordination of insurance coverage and benefits to help determine pricing and access for prescribed home medical equipment and supplies.
